lede: The biggest thing on the docket this week is Wednesday's Town Council meeting, where two ordinances get first readings and Council takes up the Fourth Supplement to the Gondola IGA — real decisions with real money attached. That same Wednesday, P&Z hears the long-delayed Shandoka Lot Redevelopment PUD at 860 Black Bear Rd, and the Telluride Hospital District board weighs possible action on a Two Site Model that could reshape how care gets delivered in this valley for years to come.
